model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the sharpness composition for a ViT model on ImageNet1k over the course of training steps. The x-axis represents "Training Steps" on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to slightly beyond 37700, with numeric tick marks spaced at regular intervals of 7540. The y-axis represents "Sharpness composition" on a logarithmic scale, with major ticks ranging from 10⁻³ to 10⁰ at intervals of one order of magnitude. The plot contains two lines. The solid blue line, which has no markers, begins below the visible y-axis minimum at 0 training steps, rises extremely rapidly to peak slightly above 10⁰ before the 7540 mark, and then gradually declines with slight noise, ending at approximately 6×10⁻¹ at 37700 training steps. The solid orange line, also lacking markers, starts at exactly 10⁰ at 0 training steps, sharply decreases to roughly 5×10⁻¹ early in the training process, and then exhibits a steady, slightly noisy upward trend across the remainder of the x-axis, finishing near 8×10⁻¹ at 37700 training steps.
